headword: {国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}
reading: こくみんけんこうほけん

definitions.explanation: Japan's public health insurance program for residents who are not covered by employer-based insurance. Administered by municipal governments and mandatory for all eligible residents, including self-employed workers, students, and retirees.

examples.japanese: {国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}した→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: I enrolled in National Health Insurance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}える→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When you leave your job, you need to switch from company insurance to National Health Insurance.

examples.japanese: {国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{前年|ぜんねん}→前年：23906_zennen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{所得|しょとく}→所得：09850_shotoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいて→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}される→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: National Health Insurance premiums are calculated based on the previous year's income, so the burden increases with higher earnings.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧ (citizens, nationals), ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧ (health), and ⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧ (insurance). Almost always abbreviated to {国保|こくほ} in everyday speech and written communication. An essential term for anyone living in Japan, as all residents must be enrolled in some form of health insurance.

USAGE:
Japan's universal healthcare system has two main pillars: employer-based insurance (⟦{社会保険|しゃかいほけん}→社会保険：18894_shakaihoken⟧ or {社保|しゃほ}) and National Health Insurance ({国保|こくほ}). The latter covers the self-employed, part-time workers not eligible for employer plans, students, and those between jobs. Foreign residents in Japan are also required to enroll.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧: to enroll in NHI
- {国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}{料|りょう}: NHI premiums
- {国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}{証|しょう}: NHI card
- {国保|こくほ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}える→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧: to switch to NHI

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国保|こくほ}: NHI (abbreviation) — the standard short form used in everyday speech
- ⟦{社会保険|しゃかいほけん}→社会保険：18894_shakaihoken⟧: social insurance — employer-based health and pension insurance
- ⟦{健康保険|けんこうほけん}→健康保険：18475_kenkouhoken⟧: health insurance — can refer to any health insurance, but often specifically means employer-based health insurance
- {後期高齢者医療制度|こうきこうれいしゃいりょうせいど}: late-stage elderly medical care system — the insurance system for those aged 75 and over
